run_alphafold_inference: run AlphaFold 3 end-to-end inference on a protein-ligand input JSON and validate output structure
test_model_inference_featurised: test AlphaFold 3 model inference using a pre-featurised example and extract embeddings
test_process_fold_input_only_inference: test that process_fold_input runs only inference when no data pipeline config is provided
